purpose: Physical surface research only. No photograph is a render texture, height map, or proof of complete reconstruction.

photos.notes: Full front with silver-rim and picture-background foil visible; Leafeon silhouette, evolution portrait, species strip and rules remain opaque. Capture method unconfirmed, so this is coverage evidence only, never relief evidence.

Independent full front with complementary yellow reflection across picture background and rim. Subject remains printed; flowers retain pale printed petals. Vertical scratch/artifact is not a manufactured foil region. Capture method unconfirmed.

Physical full front on clear stand under strong directional light. Rainbow foil in picture background, flames including those crossing the tail, and silver outer rim. Flareon and its mane/tail are opaque between the flame openings; evolution portrait, species strip and rules are opaque. Stand obscures a small bottom rim segment. Smooth retail holo, no etched relief inferred.

Physical sleeved full front with directional rainbow bands in water/coral background and outer rim. Subject, fins, white neck frill, portrait, species strip and rules stay opaque. Small water bubbles overlapping the left shoulder and lower edge transmit foil separately. Sleeve glare is not relief.

Independent full physical front held against blue background. All corners visible; useful left art, upper-right background and border striae. Lower ball/textbox still dark; does not establish complete relief.
Full physical front held in hand; upper engraving, silver border and large lower Master Ball. Lower dark areas need complementary illumination.
Same specimen tilted into directional light. Clear concentric striae across subject and upper artwork; smooth printed portrait and species strip; M and large ball visible. Some highlights saturate.
Independent full specimen in sleeve/toploader. Confirms art/body coverage, large ball, faceted rules background and white print exclusions. Sleeve reflections and fine detail loss remain.
Lower-right close-up; strong curved ridges across subject and adjacent background. Lower-right textbox is dark/soft; entire lower surface is not resolved.
Upper-right corner close-up. Header/outer rim ridges and artwork respond differently from printed frame and symbols. Subject dark; incomplete line visibility.
Lower-left close-up. Facet boundaries, large ball rim, left border and art striae visible. Textbox fine ridges partly out of focus.
Upper-left close-up confirms portrait/frame and header placement. Dark art and weak lighting do not resolve every ridge.
Listing claims Poke Ball but image does not reveal its motif or etching. Cannot authenticate the printing from this image; do not use to infer a smooth surface.
Full physical front in toploader; upper etched lines are visible, lower motif is hidden by lighting. Supports upper region only, not complete variant verification alone.
Card back, not complementary front lighting.
Strong near-front directional exposure. Large single Poke Ball, differently oriented body facets, fine art/header/outer-border etching. Fine upper subject detail remains dark and needs another angle.
Card back.

Second oblique front of the same specimen. Confirms ball-region and lower-body facet placement through changed highlights, plus side/bottom ridges. Fine subject linework still mostly dark; extreme right bottom is cropped.

Detailed near-flat front with visible flowing lines across border, uniform and background. Face is quieter; printed header and Supporter rule panel differ. Capture method is not established; this cannot replace multiple directional photographs.
Physical card on easel, but card occupies too few pixels to resolve complete etched linework. Useful overall material/identity comparison only.
Physical full front. Wavy background and border lines visible; character, turquoise frame and typography have different responses. One exposure does not establish complete relief.
PSA slab front reached via listing redirect to product 7074376153. Gold border directional lines and granular field visible; no complementary lighting. Slab glare must not become relief.
Physical front in sleeve/toploader over bubble wrap. Weak blue-cast lighting, insufficient sharpness for etched lines.
Back. Listing/gallery text is not reliable evidence of image contents.
Back close-up.
Full front on display stand, weak diffuse light. Fine upper-border lines visible, center largely unresolved. Seller authenticity is not independently certified.
Top-right close-up. Some edge engraving resolved, background and character still lack directional highlights.
Lower-left close-up. Local border wave/fan engraving and textured Energy fill visible. Do not convert printed illustration edges into height.
Lower-right edge and rule panel. Fine side-border lines faint; display stand occludes bottom edge. Not full lower-region coverage.
Back corner close-up.
Grading-app screenshot, not original high-resolution directional photography. App grade is not physical authenticity or texture evidence.
Grading-app score screenshot, no useful card-surface evidence.
Full regular holo front. Silver rim and art background differ from smooth printed subject and body. Weak light; does not establish etched structure (this printing is not textured).
Low resolution front with uncertain capture method; supporting identity only. Not relief or directional structure evidence.

Physical sleeved front in directional light. Horizontal smooth holo sheet visible in picture background and outer rim. Subject and body retain opaque print; no embossed texture. Sleeve highlight at upper-left excluded.

Detailed front with flowing background and border lines, different character hair/uniform response, smoother skin/header/rule panel. Capture method not established; cannot alone satisfy physical multi-angle evidence.
Handheld sleeved front, all corners present. Edge and right-background line flow visible; hand occludes left field and weak light leaves uniform/skin fine structure unresolved.

Physical front flat on wood with light raking from the left. Confirms flowing lower/left-background and sky lines, hair/uniform structure and comparatively smooth skin/header/rules. Right-side fine lines remain too soft for complete tracing.
Physical full front, weak directional foil visibility. Picture background has horizontal sheet lines; rod and balls show opaque printed surfaces.

Strong horizontal-strand diamond sheet visible in art background, outer magenta rim and ACE SPEC rail. Max Rod main body and balls remain predominantly opaque. Pink rules field has weaker patterned response; lettering stays opaque.

Detailed full front resolves background, rim and ACE rail sheet. Foil is visible inside green crystal and vial contents, not across the opaque belt casing, buckle housing and vial caps. Capture method unconfirmed; no raised texture inferred.
Composite front/back uses the same exposure as image a at lower resolution. Not an independent lighting reference.

Full front shows diamond horizontal sheet in background, rim, rail and selected blue portions of device/tubes. Orange casing and grip are opaque. Capture method unconfirmed; no etched relief inferred.

Physical angled full front, strong directional light. Diamond sheet crosses pink rules field and border as well as artwork background. Green transparent energy regions show foil; gray mechanical shell and rule panel remain opaque.
Physical front on stand shows strong background/rim diamonds and header/rail foil. Main crystal stays predominantly smooth printed artwork. Stand hides small footer regions.

Complementary full front with unobstructed footer; confirms predominantly smooth main crystal against horizontally patterned background. Fine green rear facet may transmit some foil; not enough contrast to resolve its exact boundary.

Physical full front on a white surface under direct flash. Strong diamond sheet in background, rails, rim and pink rules field stops at the crystal silhouette. Specular laminate glare also crosses the crystal; it is not a continuation of the diamond grating and must not become a height map.

Complementary full front of the same physical specimen under diffuse directional light, without central flash glare. Crystal facets, including the narrow green rear facet, retain printed shading while neighboring background carries strong horizontal lines. Together with the direct-flash view supports keeping crystal illustration opaque; no coherent foil lines across the green rear facet are confirmed.

Physical tilted front reveals diamond sheet across background, pink rules field, rim and rails. Green housing/dish/binoculars/compass are opaque; radar display and red indicator transmit the sheet. No embossed contour relief.

High-detail physical views with different lighting orientations; confirm face, uniform, background and border transitions.
Complementary angles resolving character, smooth print regions, frame, all edges and background engraving.
Complementary unclipped front photographs with less slab glare covering gold background, Pikachu, crown, rules and every edge.
Strong directional macro photography of the entire center, character, background ornaments, upper-left region and unoccluded bottom edge. Confirm across independent physical specimens.
